LocalCartesianCRS.gml:description: Two-dimensional local Cartesian coordinate reference system for a vertical trench wall. The X-axis runs horizontally along the wall face (bearing ~37° from North), and the D-axis (depth) points vertically downward. Origin is at the top southwest corner of the wall. The wall is approximately 18.1 meters wide and 5.5 meters deep.
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:name: Local Coordinate System for Trench b11
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:scope: Trench wall mapping and geological logging with 2D representation
Documentation of soil layers, contacts, and features on vertical exposure in trench B11

gml:CartesianCS.gml:name: Trench Wall 2D Cartesian CS
gml:CartesianCS.gml:remarks: Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system for trench wall with X along wall (horizontal) and D downward (depth from top of wall)

gml:CoordinateSystemAxis.gml:name: X - Horizontal Along Wall
gml:CoordinateSystemAxis.gml:remarks: Horizontal axis running along the trench wall face from southwest to northeast (bearing ~37°). Origin is at the southwest corner at the top of the wall.

gml:CoordinateSystemAxis.gml:name: D - Depth Below Top of Wall
gml:CoordinateSystemAxis.gml:remarks: Depth axis pointing vertically downward from the top of the wall. D=0 is at the top of the wall. Positive values indicate increasing depth downward.

gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:name: Trench Wall 2D Local Datum
gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:remarks: Datum defined by the southwest corner at the top of the trench wall
gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:anchorDefinition: Origin point at top of trench wall, southwest corner, elevation 5.0 m NAVD88. The wall extends approximately 5.5 meters downward to elevation -0.50 m NAVD88 at the deepest point.

PointLocation.gml:description: Origin (0,0) at top of trench wall, southwest corner. UTM Zone 11N (EPSG:26911) + NAVD88 height (EPSG:5703). Origin location must be in a spatial CRS to allow for transformation of local coordinates to spatial coordinates.

LocalCartesianCRS.gml:description: Two-dimensional local Cartesian coordinate reference system for Patch 1 of the DogLeg Trench. The X-axis runs horizontally along the patch face (bearing 78 degrees from North), and the D-axis (depth) points vertically downward. Origin is at the reference point (SW end of Patch 1), ground elevation 6.2 m. Patch is 48 m long and reaches 5.2 m maximum depth.
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:name: Local Coordinate System for DogLeg Trench Patch 1
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:scope: Trench wall mapping and geological logging with 2D representation

gml:CartesianCS.gml:name: DogLeg Patch 1 2D Cartesian CS
gml:CartesianCS.gml:remarks: Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system for Patch 1 with X along the patch (bearing 78 degrees) and D downward (depth from reference point)

gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:name: DogLeg Trench Patch 1 Local Datum
gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:anchorDefinition: Origin at DogLeg Trench reference point, elevation 6.2 m NAVD88. Patch 1 extends 48 m along a bearing of 78 degrees to the junction with Patch 2 at elevation 4.8 m, reaching a maximum trench depth of 5.2 m (elevation 1.0 m).

PointLocation.gml:description: Origin (0,0) at DogLeg Trench reference point (SW end of Patch 1).

LocalCartesianCRS.gml:description: Two-dimensional local Cartesian coordinate reference system for Patch 2 of the DogLeg Trench. The X-axis runs horizontally along the patch face (bearing 110 degrees from North), and the D-axis (depth) points vertically downward. Origin is at the Patch 1/Patch 2 junction, ground elevation 4.8 m. Patch is 37 m long and reaches 6.5 m maximum depth (below its own origin; -3.4 m absolute elevation). Local X-coordinates are expressed in a continuous chainage shared with Patch 1 via the X-axis AxisLocation's originOffset (48).
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:name: Local Coordinate System for DogLeg Trench Patch 2
LocalCartesianCRS.gml:scope: Trench wall mapping and geological logging with 2D representation

gml:CartesianCS.gml:name: DogLeg Patch 2 2D Cartesian CS
gml:CartesianCS.gml:remarks: Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system for Patch 2 with X along the patch (bearing 110 degrees) and D downward (depth from junction point)

gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:name: DogLeg Trench Patch 2 Local Datum
gml:EngineeringDatum.gml:anchorDefinition: Origin at the Patch 1/Patch 2 junction, elevation 4.8 m NAVD88. Patch 2 extends 37 m along a bearing of 110 degrees to its east end at elevation 6.75 m, reaching a maximum trench depth of 6.5 m below origin (absolute elevation -3.4 m).

PointLocation.gml:description: Origin (local X=48 after offset, D=0) at the Patch 1/Patch 2 junction (west end of Patch 2).

TrenchWall.gml:description: A dog-leg shaped trench wall consisting of two contiguous surfaceMember panels at different bearings (78 and 110 degrees from North), used to test CompositeSurface rendering with per-member local coordinate reference systems.
TrenchWall.gml:name: DogLeg Trench
Trench DL-1

Remark.content: Trench alignment changes bearing partway along its length, hence "DogLeg" naming; used as a test fixture for CompositeSurface rendering.
Field crew noted stable side-wall conditions throughout excavation; no shoring required beyond the initial 2 m.

Environment.gml:name: Site conditions during DogLeg Trench excavation

TrenchWall.shoring: None required below 2 m depth; benched sides above 2 m per OSHA Type B soil requirements.

Remark.content: Backhoe with 1 m wide bucket used to excavate the full dog-leg alignment in a single pass per patch.

TrenchConstructionMethod.gml:name: hand trimming
TrenchConstructionMethod.trenchStability: Stable; no sloughing observed during hand-trimming of wall face.

Remark.content: Excavated in three passes; panel boundaries mark each day's work, not a change in wall alignment or coordinate frame.

Lithology.lithDescription: tight well graded gravel with coarse sand; minor silt and clay
